column3: Close to the Hebrew; The plural “wisdoms” is rendered “Wisdom.”
Close to the Hebrew; “She has slaughtered her slaughtering” is rendered “She has prepared her food.”
Close to the Hebrew; “One lacking of heart” is rendered “him who lacks understanding.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Foolish things” is rendered “your folly.”
NASB adds “gets … for himself” in the second line, and “his defect” is rendered “insults.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “instruction” (“Give instruction to a wise man”).
Close to the Hebrew; “The holy [ones]” (plural form) is rendered “the Holy One.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A woman of folly [is] boisterous, naivete” is rendered “The woman of folly is boisterous, She is naive.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “eaten” (“bread eaten in secret”).
Close to the Hebrew; “The shades” (rephaim) is rendered “the dead,” and “her invited ones” as “her guests.”
